contexts.text: According to the varied mingling of dark and light.
A face of snowy paleness.
With such there appears a snowy light. AC 4416. AC 5128:3, Explained. AE 1072.
Whiter than snow, and fairer than milk () = in celestial truth. AE 364:5.
To wash, and be made whiter than snow () = to be purified from sins by the reception and putting on of the Lord's righteousness.
A little snowy one went out of his body, which represented their desire to put on a state of innocence. AC 4082.
The man of the Church is then like the earth covered with snow.
Snow is predicated of truth. AC 8459, Illustrated.
Saturn's belt appears as a snowiness...
His garment as white as snow () = its external truth.
Their noses are more of a snowy colour.
Truths outside the Heavens shine coldly, like what is snowy, without heat. HH 482:2. Like winter, when all things lie under the snow.
It is said as wool, as snow () because... snow = truth in ultimates; for... snow is from water, which = truths of faith.
Spiritual light appears like resplendent and dazzling snow, such as His garments, when transfigured.

In the frigid zones (there) snow appears on the lands... I was once led to a region where all the land appeared covered with snow. Described... The place of worship was unseen, because covered with snow. But the custodians were removing the snow, digging a way in.
From its light (the Word) shines white like snow.
He was shown naked and snowy. Explained.
Their passive life is represented as of snowy light.
He emerged as a little snowy something like a man.
The girls appeared naked and snowy, which signified that they supposed themselves innocent.
He showed a snowy brain.
The streets are very snowy, so that it appears a snowiness which = a life of faith.
The man clothed in what is snowy = those represented by Noah.
That snowiness then became black. Explained.
Nordberg appeared snowy as to the body and hands.
Under England, see this reference.
Melancthon's species of persuasion appeared snowy.
When this Hell was opened there appeared a striped snowiness. Explained.
Snow = truth in ultimates, because it is from water and from its whiteness.
That truth is described by snow. Illustrated. AE 372:5. AE 1042:8.
The snow of Lebanon = the truths of the Church thence. Snow here, = the like as water, namely, truths; but snow = cold truths, because such a Church is treated of.
Snow and vapours () = the scientifics and Knowledges of the natural man; for these are snow and vapour before the man has become spiritual...
Waters of snow () = truths which are, or which appear, genuine. AE 481:7.
The snow coming down from heaven () = natural truth (appropriated to man), which is like snow when only in the memory, but becomes spiritual through love, as snow becomes the water of rain by heat.
Under Hail, see this reference.
In the light of Heaven, their mind appears snowy, such as is rational light.
His garments as white as snow = Divine truth.
(Plant-like forms in snow. Explained.)
4. Still, their exteriors appear snowy and crimson from (external) uses.
